risk: Memory remains as effective as or stronger than abstraction
leading_indicator: Pure retrieval equals/beats skills under fair held-out comparison
mitigation: Phase5 matched budgets; novel combinations/contexts; hybrid arm
decision_if_realized: Narrow or reject abstraction-superiority claim; characterize when each strategy helps

risk: SCV adds no incremental selection value
leading_indicator: SCV selects same candidates as frequency/always/random or predicts no held-out value
mitigation: Phase1 pressure audit; Phase4 constrained candidate capacity; independent outcome labels
decision_if_realized: Keep SCV as heuristic only or retire claim; publish null

risk: Transfer-aware ranking continues to tie frequency
leading_indicator: Policy rankings still coincide despite designed candidate conflict
mitigation: Phase1 verify disagreement on development pools; Phase3 blinded test
decision_if_realized: Report no incremental ranking effect; do not weaken gate posthoc

risk: ARC coverage remains low after DSL expansion
leading_indicator: Full-inventory exact demo-fit/trace success remains sparse or expansion only fits demos
mitigation: Phase2 held-out coverage audit, budget parity, task-level accuracy; Phase10 external test
decision_if_realized: Do not activate downstream theory claims; revise representation or stop ARC chain

risk: Capability measures fail independent behavioral validation
leading_indicator: C_t/CGR does not predict external task breadth/persistence beyond prior skill/exposure
mitigation: Phase7 independent outcomes, preregistered prediction and baselines
decision_if_realized: Relabel/redefine internal score; do not claim capability growth

leading_indicator: IG adds no prediction of future learning/adaptation on independent criterion
mitigation: Phase8 external outcome and baseline-adjusted validation
decision_if_realized: Retire intelligence label; retain only as internal composite if useful

risk: Pressure benchmark fails to create meaningful policy disagreement
leading_indicator: Candidate pools lack positive/negative/neutral choices or all policies choose same action
mitigation: Preflight diagnostics on development split before confirmation
decision_if_realized: Redesign benchmark before outcome lock; do not score superiority

leading_indicator: Effect directions vanish under new generator or trace implementation
mitigation: Phase9 independent generator and vocabulary replication
decision_if_realized: Restrict claim to original generator; document boundary

risk: Metric or split leakage biases results
leading_indicator: Candidate labels, test outcomes, or task IDs influence policy/tuning; heldout mismatch
mitigation: Provenance audit, locked splits, hashes, access controls, independent reviewer
decision_if_realized: Invalidate confirmatory claim and rerun only on new untouched split

leading_indicator: Configured candidate budget differs from executed discovery/arms
mitigation: Single source-of-truth config; runtime assertions; per-task trial logs; hashed notebook
decision_if_realized: Block run and report nonconformance; no posthoc correction of metric

risk: New v1.1 thresholds are selected after seeing outcomes
leading_indicator: Threshold/endpoint changes after pilot or confirmatory outcomes
mitigation: Separate pilot and confirmatory splits; preregister SESOI/analysis before confirmation
decision_if_realized: Reclassify as exploratory; reserve new holdout

leading_indicator: Wide cluster intervals, sparse candidates, or zero-variance contrasts
mitigation: Power analysis at independent unit; cluster-aware design; avoid pseudoreplication
decision_if_realized: Classify inconclusive; do not overstate point estimates

leading_indicator: Rankings change materially across plausible creation/reuse costs
mitigation: Precalibrate costs; report cost and success components separately; sensitivity plan frozen
decision_if_realized: Restrict claims to chosen cost model or report policy tradeoff

risk: Competition deadline pressure compromises research quality
leading_indicator: v1.1 experimental roadmap is conflated with v1.0 paper or deadlines force unplanned protocol changes
mitigation: Separate any v1.0 Kaggle entry from v1.1 evidence; follow actual competition requirements; do not imply unrun studies
decision_if_realized: Submit only transparent v1.0 scope or defer competition; no fabricated v1.1 claims

risk: Comparator mismatch makes memory/compression claims ambiguous
leading_indicator: B2/B4 implementation, budgets, or task access differ across arms/phases
mitigation: Freeze comparator definitions and common interfaces; publish versions and budgets
decision_if_realized: Limit each claim to its named comparator/protocol

risk: ARC demo-fit coverage is mistaken for solved task accuracy
leading_indicator: Reports merge coverage scan, arm candidates, and test output success
mitigation: Separate metrics, denominators, and tables; audit labels
decision_if_realized: Correct claim before publication; disallow coverage-as-accuracy statement
